models: Text AutoAugment (TAA) with operations: Random Swap, Random Delete, WordNet Substitute, TF-IDF Substitute, TF-IDF Insert
outputs: augmented text instances via editing operations such as synonym substitution, random swap, and deletion

changes_made.explanation: Simplified task to 'Paraphrase Generation' since the paper focuses on generating paraphrased text variants. Normalized model names and simplified output descriptions.

automatic_metrics: semantic preservation score (based on Sentence-BERT cosine similarity)

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant metric descriptions and added primary evaluation metrics (test accuracy, validation loss) used to evaluate the augmentation effectiveness.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper only mentions using Sentence-BERT for semantic similarity calculation.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper. Only automatic metrics were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on data augmentation for text classification, specifically generating augmented text instances via various editing operations. While the primary application is text classification, the methods involve generating paraphrased text variants, qualifying it as NLG evaluation. The paper primarily uses automatic metrics (Dist-2, semantic similarity) to evaluate the quality and diversity of generated texts.
